dataset_name: Continuous Daily Pool Water Quality & Operational Time Series
imputation_methodology: Physics-Informed Kinetic Bridge (Alicante solar photolysis, temperature decay, automated pump influx, tablet dissolution kinetics, weather-weighted terminal boundary calibration)
gaps_and_limitations: Calendar gaps > 14 days (winter shutdowns, seasonal closures) are not interpolated; boundary-only rows are emitted.
Water temperature is estimated from ambient air temperature and pool type, not directly measured for imputed days.
Bather load is approximated via weekend flags and community pool type, not from direct occupancy counts.
